newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche sees higher sales, profits - bank.
newsitem.headline: Porsche sees higher sales, profits - bank.

text.p: German car maker Porsche AG expects profits and sales to rise considerably in the business year that ends on July 31, according to a statement by BW Bank after an analysts' meeting with the company.
The bank said in a statement that Porsche sales totalled 2.8 billion marks last year and net profit was 49.8 million marks.
"In the current year they are aiming at (sales of) 3.6 billion marks ... and (net profit) will cross the 100 million marks threshold," it said.

The bank cited Porsche chief finance officer Holger Haerter as saying that the company was going through a boom of "historical dimensions" that was largely attributed to the popularity of its Boxter and 911 models.
